name: realtext-v1-optimization-check
primary_metric: late-query relative attention-output squared error using actual frozen-model value vectors; lower is better
candidate_gate: Both preselected layers must show >1% relative mean output-error reduction versus selected_only and selected_budget_match, with consistent sign for all 3 paired seeds versus selected_only. Gate is only permission to investigate further locally, not evidence of native-training efficacy.
scope: Frozen Pythia attention traces from real text; no backbone updates; no Qwen architectural claim; logical score budget is not measured GPU cost.
limits: Small paragraphs rather than long documents
3 indexer seeds do not repeat backbone pretraining
No test checkpoint selection or post-result parameter sweep
revision_reason: Full-supervision positive control has zero gradients in layer 1 at original learning rate. Uniform 10x lower LR and 10x more steps across every method, not a candidate-only sweep.
interpretation: Exploratory repair using existing splits; final test set was inspected in v0 and is not a fresh confirmatory sample.
